findings.summary: 143 tracks in one long table with no recommendation or starting point, which feels overwhelming
Many rows show 'less than 3 years' instead of a return, so those tracks can't be compared
Fees are shown only as percents with no shekel amount, so the reader can't tell how much the difference matters
The same track names repeat under every company, so it's hard to tell what differs
The return column header doesn't say whether the figure is per year or total, or what 'before management fees' changes
The exposure percents are confusing for a track called 'stocks'
No next step and no explanation of how to open the fund
